senses.gloss: (b. h. אִי) Interj. Eh! Oh! Woe! Targ. Y. II, Lev. XXVI, 29.—
units: <cite ref="Taanit 7a:17">Taan. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>אי חכמה וכ׳</he> Oh, for such a brilliant mind in such an ugly vessel (body)! <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 19a:6">R. Hash. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>אי שמים</he> Oh heavens!; a. fr.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:4:7">Y. Shek. V, end, 49ᵇ</cite> <he>אי לי שאני וכ׳</he> woe unto me, that I thus see thee! <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 13:7:4">Y. Yeb. XIII, 14ᵃ</cite> top; a. fr. [Babli, usually <cite ref="A00628"><he>אוֹי</he></cite>.]
